summary: Iteration 111 — full e2e (web + backend) verification of the 4 new features on top of News Radio + owner artwork. 15/15 pytest PASS + all 4 UI flows proven live. #2 Voice preview: GET /api/news_radio/voices returns 5 voices each carrying sample_url=/api/static/voice_samples/<voice_id>.mp3; a HEAD/GET on the sample serves 200 audio/mpeg. The reusable VoicePicker (data-testid=voice-picker) renders 5 rows (voice-option-<id>) each with a Play preview button (voice-preview-<id>) that spawns an <Audio> on click (verified click, no console errors, and cyan check on the currently-selected row). #4 Per-market picker on /radio/news: as ADMIN the section (data-testid=news-radio-voice-picker) is visible; the market <select data-testid=news-radio-voice-market> exposes exactly ['global','dubai','dfw','new_york']. Switching to 'dubai' highlights Raghav (default 8vqXJx9Riwp7L4KLhsU3); clicking Sarah row fires POST /api/admin/news-radio/voice {voice_id:'EXAVITQu4vr4xnSDxMaL', market:'dubai'} → 200, 'Regenerating clips…' label appears, and GET /voices reflects the new mapping. As DEMO user AND as ANON the picker is ABSENT (correct). Backend gate: POST /voice by anon/demo → 401/403; unknown voice → 400 {detail:{error:unknown_voice}}. Server-side market_voices defaults on empty settings: dubai→Raghav, dfw & new_york→Sarah — all verified. #1 Per-station intro on /live-radio/station/imp_96063f25060111e8ae (admin=owner-equiv): owner-artwork-manager renders owner-intro-manager which contains a VoicePicker (5 voice rows) + owner-intro-generate button. Clicking Generate after selecting Charlie POSTed /api/imported-stations/imp_96063f25060111e8ae/intro/generate {voice_id:'IKne3meq5aSn9XLyUdCD'} → 200 {ok, intro_url:'/api/static/station_intros/imp_96063f25060111e8ae.mp3', voice_id, voice_name}; owner-intro-audio <audio> then rendered inline with src pointing to the mp3, and GET on the mp3 returned 200 audio/mpeg (~0:07 clip in the UI). Toast 'Station intro generated' fired. Backend gate: anon and demo (non-owner, non-admin) both → 403 on GET+POST; unknown voice → 400. #3 Art style-note: owner-art-style-note text input renders inside owner-artwork-manager (max 220 chars). Typing 'TEST_neon_cyberpunk_ui_moody_purple' and clicking owner-art-generate POSTs /artwork/generate with {style_note:'TEST_neon_...'} → 200 body {ok:true, status:'queued', prompt:'...Style direction from the owner: TEST_neon_cyberpunk_ui_moody_purple...', style_note:'TEST_neon_...'}. Non-owner (demo) → 403. Regression: owner-art-history + owner-art-history-0 still render (2 thumbs visible after test); news-radio-audio-badge still shows on /radio/news for demo user; no console errors of significance (only expected /api/auth/me 401 on anon/logged-out state).

issues: The 'Regenerating clips…' status only shows next to the market select while the async poll loop runs (up to 30s); no timeout indicator or 'Done' toast is shown when the batch completes. Non-blocking but a small polish opportunity.

critical_code_review_comments: backend/routes/imported_station_artwork.py:349 _INTRO_DIR is a hard-coded absolute path (/app/backend/storage/station_intros). Fine for the container but should be resolved off a shared STORAGE_ROOT env like the news_clips path for portability.

backend/routes/imported_station_artwork.py:355-360 station-intro upload to object storage is best-effort with a bare `except Exception: pass` — good for keeping the local disk path serving, but silently swallows Tigris errors. Consider logging at WARN so ops can catch a mis-configured bucket.

backend/services/news_radio_settings.py:86 set_anchor_voice invalidates ALL cached news_audio_url rows on a global-voice change and per-market rows on a market change — correct semantics, but rapid A/B flipping between two voices will keep re-rendering (~2-3s/clip × top_n). Consider a short debounce or a UI confirm before flipping.

frontend/src/components/VoicePicker.jsx:14 audioRef is set to null after pause but not on preview() re-entry with a different voice — the previous voice's audio is paused (correct) but a fresh Audio() is created each time; browsers cap concurrent Audio elements low, so this is fine, just noting no reuse.

frontend/src/NewsRadio.jsx:99-106 the changeVoice() poll loop does 6 × 5s = up to 30s of polling with no cancel-on-unmount — if the admin navigates away mid-poll the async loop keeps running (no state update after unmount but wastes bandwidth). Minor.
test_credentials: admin@bigfm.dubai/AdminPass123! (voice-picker + station-owner-equiv), demo@bigfm.dubai/DemoPass123! (non-owner, non-admin). Cookie-based via POST /api/auth/login.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Live evidence (2026-06 iter111 against REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=https://mobile-games-v2.preview.emergentagent.com): (1) GET /api/news_radio/voices returns {voices:[5 curated w/ sample_url], global_voice_id, market_voices:{dubai:'8vqXJx9Riwp7L4KLhsU3', dfw:'EXAVITQu4vr4xnSDxMaL', new_york:'EXAVITQu4vr4xnSDxMaL'}} — publicly readable, no auth. Non-owner/admin → 403. (6) UI selectors verified live on /radio/news: [data-testid=news-radio-voice-picker] (admin-only), [data-testid=news-radio-voice-market] (select w/ 4 options), [data-testid=voice-picker] (reusable), [data-testid=voice-option-<id>] (5x), [data-testid=voice-preview-<id>] (5x).
